page.overview:
Who is Evans Basch?

Evans Basch was a human male engineer who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was aboard the refugee vessel Dorlanna before it was destroyed, and later stationed on the Millennium Falcon during the Battle of Endor.

Evans Basch first appeared in Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi, as an unnamed crew member aboard the Millennium Falcon. He was first identified in the comic Hyperspace Stories 12.
